info.name: BrandFlow — Transparent PNG Overlay Frames & Dynamic Config Engine
info.description: API endpoints for creating, fetching, and managing Canva-style transparent PNG overlay frames with vector element configuration JSON schemas.

request.description: Fetches all transparent PNG overlay frames along with their configJson vector slot schemas.
